contact.address: 948, 12th Main Rd, HAL 2nd Stage, Indiranagar / Ground Floor, RMZ Ecoworld Rd, Bellandur, Bengaluru 560038

colour_palette.details: Uses high-energy fast-casual yellow (#fccc24) and cobalt blue (#116dff). The contrast is lively, but lacks custom dark mode tokens and luxury warmth.

logo.details: Logo is served as a Wix-hosted 180x180 PNG asset without high-resolution SVG rendering, creating blurriness on 4K/Retina displays.

typography.details: Standard Wix sans-serif font stack. Clean readability but misses the gritty, energetic comic-book typography of authentic smash burger joints.

contact.details: Active phone line across both Indiranagar and Bellandur outlets, verified Instagram presence, and clear physical addresses.

online_presence.details: Wix site with reservation widgets and online ordering redirects. High JavaScript bundle weight slows initial mobile rendering.

verdict.commercial_rationale: High-volume smash burger brand with two flagship tech-hub locations (Indiranagar & RMZ Ecoworld). An ultra-fast Next.js scrollytelling web app with instant click-to-order capability will elevate direct takeout conversions.
